subject.title: fix(searxng): fail closed on unresolved base url refs

question: Should SearXNG replace the shipped ambient fallback with fail-closed behavior when an explicitly configured base URL is unavailable, blank, or malformed?
rationale: Code correctness and proof are strong, but the change intentionally removes a released fallback for some installations and therefore needs explicit ownership of the compatibility-versus-routing-safety tradeoff.

options.title: Accept fail-closed routing
options.body: Land the documented behavior because preventing silent requests to an unintended endpoint outweighs compatibility with the old fallback.

options.title: Add explicit compatibility mode
options.body: Preserve ambient fallback by default and introduce strict behavior only through a separately approved option with fresh-install and upgrade coverage.

options.title: Retain the current fallback
options.body: Pause or close the PR if uninterrupted availability is preferred over enforcing the explicitly configured target.

recommendation.title: Accept fail-closed routing
recommendation.body: Land the documented behavior because preventing silent requests to an unintended endpoint outweighs compatibility with the old fallback.

likelyOwner.reason: The current-main fallback being changed appears in Peter Steinberger's recent SearXNG SecretRef implementation, making him the strongest available owner for this compatibility decision.
